svg.text: PROJECT MANAGEMENT · ISSUE TRACKING · DEVELOPMENT INSIGHTS
Two connected paths represent issues moving through a workflow. Where the paths
meet, a shared node stands for collaboration, traceability and tool integrations.
Starting design concept: not trademark-cleared or production-vetted.
Icon left, wordmark right. Header, login, docs, marketing.
Wordmark in Cloud, node lifted to #7C8EF5 for contrast.
Sidebar and compact header. Light and dark.
In the interface use one consistent Lucide set (Dashboard, Issues, Projects, Board, Analytics, GitHub, Automations).
Keep the custom mark for brand identity only; do not replace UI icons with it.
Status colors (semantic, separate from the brand palette)
Never rely on color alone: pair every status with an icon and a text label.
Wordmark: Inter SemiBold, outlined in the SVGs (no font install needed).
Application UI: Inter, consistent sizes and spacing. Flat vector, no gradients.
Buttons and cards: modest rounded corners, subtle borders.
Keep clear space of at least the height of the letter T on all sides.
Primary logo: 120 px wide minimum. Below 24 px use the favicon.
Do not recolor, stretch, rotate, outline or add shadows to the logo.
Use the dark variants on dark surfaces; never place navy on navy.
